doc: A boundary's biome (design/boundary.md), as a config entry: the colours and forms of the world it invents beyond a playable region (its rock, soil, grass, foliage, water, snow, trunks, reeds), how its trees grow, and its scale (how high cliffs and peaks rise, how deep a ledge drops, where snow and trees end).

fields.name: name
fields.doc: The biome's name.

fields.name: grass
fields.doc: Open ground's grass (linear RGB, 0 to 1).

fields.name: grass_dry
fields.doc: Dry grass, fields, and the valley's patchwork (linear RGB, 0 to 1).

fields.name: soil
fields.doc: Bare soil and paths (linear RGB, 0 to 1).

fields.name: rock
fields.doc: Rock (linear RGB, 0 to 1).

fields.name: rock_dark
fields.doc: Rock's dark strata and cracks (linear RGB, 0 to 1).

fields.name: sand
fields.doc: Sand and beaches (linear RGB, 0 to 1).

fields.name: snow
fields.doc: Snow (linear RGB, 0 to 1).

fields.name: foliage
fields.doc: Forest crowns in summer (linear RGB, 0 to 1).

fields.name: foliage_dark
fields.doc: Forest crowns' shade, and conifers (linear RGB, 0 to 1).

fields.name: jungle
fields.doc: Jungle leaves (linear RGB, 0 to 1).

fields.name: trunk
fields.doc: Trunks and branches (linear RGB, 0 to 1).

fields.name: reed
fields.doc: Reeds and marsh grass (linear RGB, 0 to 1).

fields.name: water_shallow
fields.doc: Shallow water (linear RGB, 0 to 1).

fields.name: water_deep
fields.doc: Deep water (linear RGB, 0 to 1).

fields.name: autumn
fields.doc: Broadleaf crowns in fall (linear RGB, 0 to 1).

fields.name: forest_form
fields.doc: How its forest grows.

fields.name: jungle_form
fields.doc: How its jungle grows.

fields.name: tree_height
fields.doc: Forest trees' height, metres.

fields.name: cliff_height
fields.doc: A ridge's cliff, metres above the rim.

fields.name: ledge_drop
fields.doc: How far a ledge drops to the valley floor, metres.

fields.name: peak_height
fields.doc: The highest peaks at rise 1, metres above the rim.

fields.name: snow_line
fields.doc: Where snow lies, metres above the rim (0: nowhere outside winter).

fields.name: tree_line
fields.doc: Above this, metres over the rim, no forest grows.

fields.name: sea_depth
fields.doc: How far the sea lies below the rim, metres.

fields.name: roughness
fields.doc: How rough its land is, 0 to 1.

fields.name: fields
fields.doc: How much of a valley floor is farmed (a patchwork of fields and hedges), 0 to 1.

fields.name: rivers
fields.doc: How likely a valley floor carries a river, 0 to 1.

fields.name: figure_forest
fields.doc: Tree species for a forest's figures, comma-separated tree genomes (a name repeated is likelier).

fields.name: figure_jungle
fields.doc: Tree species for a jungle's figures.

fields.name: figure_mountain
fields.doc: Tree species on a mountain's slopes.

fields.name: figure_marsh
fields.doc: Tree species in a marsh.

fields.name: figure_bushes
fields.doc: Bush species for undergrowth, comma-separated bush genomes.
